sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# 1) red pixel counts across history frames (static vs periodic?)
for i,h in enumerate(history):
    red = sum(n['pixels'] for n in h.frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='R')
    print(i, h.action, 'red_px=', red)
# 2) RIGHT probe
def player_box(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and 20<=n['pixels']<=30:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
b0 = player_box(current_frame)
res = action(['RIGHT'])
b1 = player_box(current_frame)
print('before:', b0, 'after:', b1)
print('result:', {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','no_impact','no_impact_source','game_over','level_completed']})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
